DIA.35g6 En-8(D) BRIGHT BAR."},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"4) $FLASH HARD CHROME PLATING 15 TO 20 MICRONS,HARDNESS 850."}],"comment":"The shaft diameter is specified with a g6 fit (N1) and the part receives 15–20 µm of hard chrome plating (N4), but no allowance is made for the plating thickness on this tight fit. The added plating will shift the finished size out of the g6 tolerance band, preventing proper assembly. The designer should either specify the pre-plate machining size to leave room for the coating or add a note to grind/finish the diameter after plating.","recommended_correction":"Add an undersize allowance equal to the plating thickness on the 35g6 dimension before plating, or specify that the g6 diameter is to be achieved after plating."}]}
